spread_monotonicity.overall_trend: non-monotonic — dips at d60/d90 then rises at d180/d252
spread_monotonicity.note: spread at d252 (0.0820) exceeds d30 (0.0717), so uncertainty grows long-run, but mid-range dip violates strict monotonicity

kurtosis_by_window.assessment: SEVERELY elevated — kurtosis 60-115x across all horizon windows (normal=3). The 3.33 kurtosis reported at 30d in the v2 test suite is per-cell aggregate; long-horizon shows 106-112 ATM 6M kurtosis, suggesting extreme fat tails / spike behavior throughout the path.

spatial_structure.note: smile convexity goes slightly negative at d180/d252 (flat/inverted smile at ultra-long horizons)

stationarity.assessment: mean-reverting — spread contracts 38% from early to late path. Suggests model is pulling toward a fixed attractor rather than maintaining realistic uncertainty.

cointegration.assessment: CRITICAL FAILURE — cointegration rate 25.6% vs GT 98.8%. IV-EWMA correlation is negative (-0.140) vs GT +0.812. Model completely loses mean-reversion structure at long horizons.

cross_cell_correlation.assessment: Level correlations over-correlated (gen 0.791 vs GT 0.480). Daily-change correlations under-correlated (gen 0.312 vs GT 0.467).

acf_assessment: Strong negative lag-1 ACF (-0.456) indicates excessive mean-reversion / oscillation in daily changes.

q1_does_h1_ci_improvement_persist.answer: PARTIALLY — d30 CI is 99.2% (excellent), d60 93.6%, d90 96.8%. But breaks down severely at d180 (71.2%) and partially recovers at d252 (82.8%). The near-term improvement persists but mid-range (d90-d180) collapses.

q2_does_kurtosis_blowup_worsen_at_252d.answer: YES — kurtosis is catastrophically elevated throughout the entire path (60-115x at all horizons). It does not worsen monotonically but remains extreme. The 3.33 kurtosis in the 30d v2 suite is likely a different metric (ratio vs. normal, not raw); raw kurtosis is 106+ at ATM 6M throughout.
q2_does_kurtosis_blowup_worsen_at_252d.verdict: KURTOSIS IS A FUNDAMENTAL PROBLEM ACROSS ALL HORIZONS

overall_assessment.verdict: FAIL — long-horizon generation is severely broken
strengths: Zero explosion rate at all horizons (0.000%)
Near-term CI coverage is very strong: d30=99.2%, d60=93.6%, d90=96.8%
Overall spread grows from d30 to d252 (0.0717 → 0.0820)
critical_failures: Cointegration rate 25.6% vs GT 98.8% — model loses mean-reversion structure
IV-EWMA correlation -0.140 vs GT +0.812 — negative correlation is wrong sign
Kurtosis 60-115x normal across all horizon windows — fat-tail spikes throughout
d180 CI drops to 71.2% — significant undercoverage at 9-month horizon
Spread contraction (stationarity ratio 0.62) — uncertainty collapses over time

overall_assessment.comparison_to_144b_baseline: Cannot directly compare without 144b long-horizon results, but 149c's near-term CI is excellent while long-horizon cointegration failure is likely similar to or worse than baseline given the kurtosis severity.
